title: Elf Bar 600 Pro Prefilled Pod Kits
description: The Elf Bar 600 Pro Prefilled Pod Kit is designed for vapers seeking a compact, adaptable, and highly capable Mouth-to-Lung (MTL) device. Continuing the iconic device’s evolution from the classic disposable format into a sustainable, reusable system, this pocket-friendly kit delivers a discreet level of vapour that closely mimics the sensation of a traditional cigarette. Powered by a robust 700mAh built-in battery, the Elf Bar 600 Pro is engineered to provide reliable all-day performance. A standout feature of this device is its dual-mode functionality, controlled via a dedicated button on the base. Vapers can easily toggle between Eco Mode to conserve battery life during extended outings, or Turbo Mode to boost power output for intensified flavour. A clear LED indicator keeps you informed of your battery status, while the modern USB-C port ensures rapid recharging when needed. Each kit includes a 2ml prefilled pod containing a premium 20mg nicotine salt e-liquid, formulated for a smooth throat hit and fast-acting satisfaction. Capable of delivering up to 600 puffs, the device operates via a seamless draw-activated firing mechanism with fixed airflow. Furthermore, the Elf Bar 600 Pro offers exceptional cross-compatibility; the battery unit can be used with a wide range of pods, including Elf Bar 600 , Elfa, and Elfa Pro prefilled pods, as well as refillable pod variants for those who prefer to use their own e-liquid. How To Set Up Elf Bar 600 Pro Device Step 1 Remove the device and the prefilled pod from the packaging. Step 2 Remove the silicone mouthpiece and any safety stickers from the pod. Step 3 Insert the pod securely into the top of the battery unit. Step 4 Inhale on the mouthpiece to activate the device and begin vaping. Step 5 Press the button on the base to toggle between Eco and Turbo modes. ✅ Ready to vape Elf Bar 600 Pro Kit Flavours Blueberry Captures the simple, authentic and sweet taste of freshly picked Blueberries. Cherry Ice Blends the rich, dark notes of juicy Cherry with a crisp and revitalising icy finish.
